description: This file defines the EmployeeTerminationRecord class, representing a database entity for storing employee termination information within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes properties such as termination date, note, termination reason, and associated employee, along with getter and setter methods. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and employs a decorator trait for additional functionality.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationRecord
classes.description: Represents a record of an employee's termination, including termination date, reason, notes, and associated employee details. Mapped to the 'ohrm_emp_termination' table with ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the termination record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the termination record.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns any notes associated with the termination.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets notes for the termination record.

methods.name: getTerminationReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for termination, if specified.

methods.name: setTerminationReason
methods.description: Sets the reason for employee termination.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this termination record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Assigns an Employee to this termination record.
